existingTestsCoverage.notes: No existing E2E tests cover ProjectFileEditor or ProjectPane components. Available data-testid selectors: project-file-editor, edit-mode-button, preview-mode-button, mode-toggle-group, dirty-indicator.

testCases.description: ProjectFileEditor should display with dark theme (data-color-mode='dark')
ProjectFileEditor should start in preview mode by default
Edit button should switch to edit mode
Preview button should switch to preview mode
Mode toggle button group should have consistent styling with ArtifactEditor

validationResult.exclusionReason: Project tab switch does not trigger loadProjectFiles - project-file-list never appears. Issue: Tab click via JavaScript works but React state update (activeTab) not reflected in App.tsx useEffect that triggers loadProjectFiles. Requires architecture fix.
validationResult.fixDescription: Added explicit waits (waitForClickable, waitForCondition), JavaScript click dispatch for tab switching, and increased timeouts. Tab switching works but file loading does not trigger.

validationResult.exclusionReason: Depends on UJ-001 file list display which fails. Mode toggle buttons (edit-mode-button, preview-mode-button, mode-toggle-group) not accessible because ProjectFileEditor requires file selection first.
validationResult.fixDescription: Same fix as UJ-001 - waiting improvements. Root cause is shared: project files not loading when switching to Project tab.

validationSummary.notes: Both tests excluded due to consistent failure (0/3 passes). Root cause: Clicking Project tab does not trigger file list loading. The DOM click event fires but App.tsx useState (activeTab) does not update correctly for E2E environment, so useEffect that calls loadProjectFiles is not triggered.
